blocks.name: How to Verify a Document with Arkova
blocks.description: Three steps to permanently verifiable records. Your documents never leave your device.

step.name: Upload & Fingerprint
step.text: Select your document and a unique cryptographic fingerprint (SHA-256) is generated entirely in your browser. The document itself never leaves your device — only the fingerprint moves forward.

step.name: Permanent Anchoring
step.text: The fingerprint is recorded on a public, immutable network. Anchors are batched for efficiency, reducing costs while maintaining cryptographic integrity.

step.name: Universal Verification
step.text: Anyone can verify a document by generating its fingerprint and comparing it against the permanent record. No account required — verification is open and free.
